skill_name: Write a journalistic article that summarizes the climate crisis.
workflow: Climate change is an urgent and growing crisis, with global weather patterns changing dramatically due to human-caused emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases. Rising temperatures and more extreme weather events from floods to droughts are already being observed, as well as sea level rise and ocean acidification, tipping the balance of ecosystems around the world. To address the climate crisis, countries must reduce their emissions of greenhouse gases, some of which take decades to centuries
